scope: Assembled device automorphism arithmetic: native torus substitution/public auxiliary lift, per-mask-source key switching, body-minus-switched-components assembly, and one final signed auxiliary-scale drop. Typed TFHEpp key adapters, encrypted GPU execution and full DD refresh remain unverified/incomplete.
reference_scope: CPU spectral key-row evaluation and body subtraction/auxiliary rounding must match independent full-torus raw-key products of directly substituted/lifted mask coefficients. Raw key-row polynomials are deterministic, not encrypted evaluation keys; no CUDA kernel executed.
pipeline_order: mask active input level and substitute/lift all components
initialize result with substituted body and zero masks
evaluate every mask source using its resident row-key spectra
subtract all switched components modulo the enlarged level
round once at the end to the original signed level
preflight_scope: Primitive/KS shape checks plus source-slice/level compatibility and cross-descriptor mutable/read-only buffer aliases. Uses host metadata vectors; no device allocations or tensor transfers.
host_ubsan_scope: NVCC -O1 -g -Xcompiler=-fsanitize=undefined,-fno-sanitize-recover=all,-fno-omit-frame-pointer instruments both source/test host routines and inline CPU arithmetic. Device kernels are not instrumented or executed.
historical_scope_note: Hashes/builds above describe the automorphism arithmetic revision. A later host setup adapter converts native keys/ciphertext layouts; GPU upload ownership and encrypted evaluation remain unverified.
